string-array.name: motivational_quotes
string-array.item: The pain of discipline weighs ounces. The pain of regret weighs tons.
You don\'t find willpower, you build it — one rep at a time.
Every set you log today is proof for the person you\'re becoming.
Consistency beats intensity when intensity isn\'t consistent.
The last rep is the only one that counts.
Your only competition is the log from last week.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
Progress is a whisper of iron, repeated daily.
Show up. Log it. Beat it next time.
Strength is earned in the rep nobody is watching.

resources.string: Your data stays on your phone

RedForge stores every exercise, split, workout, set, measurement, and progress photo directly on this device using a local database and local file storage only.

No RedForge account or server is required, and the app requests no INTERNET permission. Media controls use Android's system media-session access and do not read notification content.

RedForge never uploads your training data automatically. You can explicitly export a backup file when you choose; that file can then be saved wherever you decide.

Because the core data stays on your device, protect the device with a screen lock and normal device security. Uninstalling RedForge or clearing its storage removes its local data unless you have made an explicit backup.

By continuing, you acknowledge this local-first storage model.
